clips.title: The story
paras: Newcomers report in the Main Hall at Northshire Abbey in western Elwynn. From there, they reach the Hall of Arms, the Library Wing, and the abbey tower, then receive their first assignments defending Stormwind.

Trainees and clerics pass through the Main Hall after entering Northshire Abbey. The chamber links the Hall of Arms, where recruits prepare for battle, with the Library Wing and the stairs to the abbey tower. Strife in the valley reaches even this quiet place, and officers rally able newcomers to defend the kingdom's borders.
